title: My Toys
text:
I have a red ball. It is big and round. I play with it in the park.

My brother has a blue car. The car is small. We play together every day.

questions.text: How do the narrator and the brother probably feel about playing together?
options: They do not want to play

questions.text: Which toy is probably easier to carry in a pocket?

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people play and relax
shaped like a circle or ball
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Kırmızı bir topum var. Büyük ve yuvarlak. Onunla parkta oynuyorum.
Ağabeyimin mavi bir arabası var. Araba küçük. Her gün birlikte oynuyoruz.
